posts.title: Gold Panda Visuals Performance
posts.description: It was a real honour doing visuals for Gold Panda ’s headline show at ICA on 12th November. I joined him on stage to do visuals, which rarely happens outside of Algoraves. Usually visualists/VJs are bundled with the sound engineers somewhere at the back of the venue. posts.title: ALGORIDDIMS - 21st November
posts.description: On 21st November I’m back in Bristol for my first Algorave performance since 2023 to perform at ALGORIDDIMS . I’ll be there with a bunch of Algoravers from across Bristol and London. Looks like it’s going to be a regular series of events, too. Tickets can be bought here .

posts.title: Gravitons Festival 2026 Performance
posts.description: I had so much fun performing at Gravitons on Sunday. I played a set that I’ve been doing for a while now but tried out a few new things on visuals. Here’s a recording of my whole performance. For visuals I used my modular video synthesiser and BPM synced a lot of it to the music.
